title: Hank's Hair of the Dog Saloon

services.name: Private Events
services.desc: Join us at Hank’s Hair of the Dog Saloon for your next event in paradise. Whether you are looking to celebrate a birthday, corporate event, or planning your dream wedding in the Keys, our unique outdoor spaces and original menus will make your special day unforgettable! Available for holiday gatherings, corporate functions, private, semi-private events and all your event needs! Our exclusive Courtyard is the perfect location for your next event! This charming space will provide the perfect tropical, Key West atmosphere for you and your guests. Private bar & catering options available to fit any occasion. Additional fees for food & beverage, private bartender, staff gratuity and sales tax
